title: Who Is Kraggor? 🦖🍦 | MegaWheel Arena Story Ep. 2
description:
A giant footprint. Yellow eyes in the fog. Streetlights going out one by one... KRAGGOR is back, and the whole town is panicking. 🦖

But Sprinkles remembers how he smiled over a scoop of ice cream. Why does he keep coming back? A dusty box in Grandpa's garage hides a torn photo, a secret... and a little green tail. 🍦

Follow Sprinkles, Zippy, Buster and Rocky up the mountain to find the truth about the monster, while the rest of the town builds a giant net. Is Kraggor really a monster... or just lonely? 💚

Watch till the end for a surprise that opens the way to the next adventure! 🏁
